technical.title: MonoMIP introduces multi-height inverse perspective mapping for monocular 3D detection
technical.summary: MonoMIP is a dual-decoder framework for monocular 3D object detection that constructs bird's-eye view features using multi-height inverse perspective mapping across multiple elevation planes to reduce spatial distortion.
technical.why: This improves spatial reasoning and accuracy for computer vision systems operating in perspective image planes.

technical.title: Drive3R enables block-wise streaming geometric foundation models for autonomous driving
technical.summary: Drive3R is a block-wise streaming framework for continuous, long-horizon multi-view 3D reconstruction in autonomous driving, avoiding memory limits and trajectory drift.
technical.why: It solves computational bottlenecks for dense multi-view 3D reconstruction in closed-loop autonomous driving simulation.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open multimodal agent model
technical.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model featuring 12B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, and NVFP4 weights.
technical.why: Provides engineers with a massive open-weight multimodal agent model that runs efficiently on specific hardware.

technical.title: End-to-end vision-language-action policies applied to autonomous lunar rover docking
technical.summary: This work explores mapping rover observations directly to control actions using vision-language-action models to bypass measurement errors in hand-engineered navigation pipelines.
technical.why: It demonstrates the use of end-to-end VLA policies for robust robotic navigation under extreme illumination.

technical.title: Survey examines data-centric spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models
technical.summary: A new survey explores dataset construction, modalities, annotations, and fine-tuning approaches for improving spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models used in robotics and embodied agents.
technical.why: It offers a data-centric perspective on overcoming perception limitations in vision-based MLLMs.

technical.title: VideoHarness-SRSI advances recursive self-improvement for agentic video understanding
technical.summary: VideoHarness-BRSI introduces a recursive self-improvement framework to optimize execution harnesses around frozen vision-language models for complex video understanding tasks.
technical.why: It helps automate the design of reliable multi-modal execution harnesses for video analysis.

technical.title: LayerTrim achieves training-free structured pruning for reasoning language models
technical.summary: LayerTrim is a training-free structured pruning method that removes redundant MLP features while preserving attention and depth, maintaining long-form reasoning performance.
technical.why: It reduces inference costs for large language models without degrading complex reasoning capabilities.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL powers specialized agents with multimodal reasoning
technical.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL enables always-on agents to handle complex enterprise workflows requiring document reading and cross-source verification.
technical.why: It highlights the practical deployment of large multimodal models for enterprise automation agents.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open coding-optimized mixture-of-experts model
technical.summary: Muse Spark Open is an 816B mixture-of-experts model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context window, optimized for agentic coding workflows.
technical.why: Represents a major frontier open-weight model release tailored for advanced agentic software engineering.

technical.title: Meta introduces Muse Spark Open frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model
technical.summary: Meta welcomes Muse Spark Open as a new open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model designed for advanced workflows.
technical.why: Expands the availability of high-end open-weight multimodal foundation models.

business.title: Tech Giants Race to Deploy Specialized Engineering Teams
business.summary: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google are racing to build forward-deployed engineering teams as companies demand tangible returns on their massive AI investments.
business.why: Understanding enterprise deployment strategies helps engineers align technical execution with business demands for ROI.

business.summary: Anthropic reports that its third-quarter revenue stands at $16.8 billion as the company prepares for its upcoming IPO.
business.why: This massive revenue milestone highlights the rapid commercial scale of leading foundational model builders.

business.why: This signals massive capital inflows into security infrastructure overlapping with data privacy needs in AI.

business.title: Sega Pulls Remaster After Disastrous AI Upscaling Launch
business.summary: Sega is removing Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from storefronts following a disastrous launch plagued by bugs and complaints regarding AI upscaling.
business.why: It serves as a cautionary tale of market and consumer backlash against poorly implemented AI tooling in legacy products.

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 Introduces First Open-Source MoE Vision-Language Model
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a new 35B-A3B variant and the first mixture-of-experts model in the MiniCPM-V series. It combines multi-image, single-image, and video understanding with Lookahead Expert Scheduling for smooth on-device inference.
models.why: It brings efficient, high-performance visual understanding to on-device hardware using MoE architecture.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 Open Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a 740M-parameter open multimodal model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. Designed for consumer hardware, it powers low-latency on-device search, RAG, classification, and clustering.
models.why: It provides efficient, low-latency multimodal embeddings for on-device applications.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Brings Accelerated Text-to-Image Generation
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint requiring only 8 denoising steps for text-to-image generation and image editing. It uses a 7B architecture with prefix KV caching to reuse text and reference image context.
models.why: It speeds up text-to-image pipelines with reduced denoising steps.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B On-Device Reasoning Model
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B parameter reasoning model utilizing 2B active parameters per token for fast, private on-device execution. It delivers competitive agentic and tool-use performance while running faster than comparable mixture-of-experts models.
models.why: It delivers efficient agentic reasoning capabilities tailored for edge and on-device deployment.

models.title: Underdog Saluki 27B Brings Qwen3.8-27B to Low-Memory Setups
models.summary: Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 fits Qwen3.8-27B into under 8 GB using GGUF format while keeping tool-calling intact. It also supports an optional vision add-on for processing images through the OpenAI chat API locally.
models.why: It allows engineers to run large vision-language models locally under tight memory constraints.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited-OCR for Long-Horizon Document Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited-OCR is a one-shot long-horizon parsing model that supports training with ms-swift and inference via vLLM and Baidu Cloud. Its research paper and a Hugging Face Space demo are publicly available.
models.why: It provides advanced OCR capabilities for complex, long-horizon document parsing tasks.
